key_phrases: demand is greater than our supply
analysis.reasoning: The call reflects an exceptionally strong performance with record revenues across multiple segments (Gaming, Data Center). Management displays extremely high confidence, particularly regarding the long-term potential of AI and software models. While there is a clear risk disclosure regarding supply constraints (demand outstripping supply) and the termination of the Arm acquisition, the tone remains overwhelmingly optimistic. The transition from hardware-centric to software-driven revenue (Omniverse, DRIVE) is presented as a major strategic moat. Quantitative data was abundant, specifically regarding YoY growth percentages and revenue figures.
